name: limit-tracker
title: Limit Tracker
description: Track and monitor AI coding agent limits and usage across Claude, Copilot, Cursor, DeepSeek, Devin, Gemini, Codex, OpenCode Go, z.ai, Antigravity, Command Code, Kimi, Synthetic, ClinePass, Droid, MiniMax, Grok, Amp and AiHubMix
author: pfTheTrial

commands.name: agent-usage
commands.title: Usage
commands.subtitle: Track AI Agent Limits
commands.description: Show and track AI agent usage limits

commands.title: Usage
commands.subtitle: Limit Tracker
commands.description: Show AI agent usage limits in the menu bar

preferences.name: claudeLimitView

preferences.name: showCodex
preferences.label: Show Codex

preferences.title: Additional Codex Homes (Optional)

preferences.name: codexLimitView
preferences.title: Codex Limit View
preferences.description: Which Codex limit the list row and menu bar show by default

preferences.name: showCopilot
preferences.label: Show Copilot
preferences.title: Show Copilot
preferences.description: Show Copilot usage in the list

preferences.name: copilotAuthToken
preferences.title: Copilot Authorization Token (Optional)
preferences.description: Optional fallback OAuth token for Copilot usage. Usually auto-detected from GH_TOKEN or GITHUB_TOKEN. Standard PATs may not work.

preferences.name: showCursor
preferences.label: Show Cursor
preferences.title: Show Cursor
preferences.description: Show Cursor usage in the list

preferences.name: cursorCookieHeader
preferences.title: Cursor Cookie Header (Optional)
preferences.description: Optional fallback Cookie header from cursor.com. Usually auto-detected from your local Cursor.app login.

preferences.name: showDeepSeek
preferences.label: Show DeepSeek
preferences.title: Show DeepSeek
preferences.description: Show DeepSeek balance in the list

preferences.name: deepseekApiKey
preferences.title: DeepSeek API Key (Optional)
preferences.description: Auto-detected from OpenCode login (deepseek) or DEEPSEEK_API_KEY/DEEPSEEK_KEY. Fallback: paste an API key from https://platform.deepseek.com/api_keys.

preferences.name: showDevin
preferences.label: Show Devin
preferences.title: Show Devin
preferences.description: Show Devin daily/weekly quota (self-serve) or ACU limits (Enterprise)

preferences.name: devinSessionToken
preferences.title: Devin Session Token (Optional)
preferences.description: Bearer session token from app.devin.ai cookies — works on any plan for daily/weekly quota. Or set DEVIN_BEARER_TOKEN.

preferences.name: devinOrganization
preferences.title: Devin Organization (Optional)
preferences.description: Organization slug or id shown in the app.devin.ai URL. Required together with the session token. Or set DEVIN_ORGANIZATION.

preferences.name: devinApiKey
preferences.title: Devin API Key (Optional)
preferences.description: Service user key (cog_...) with ViewAccountConsumption + ManageBilling permissions. Enterprise plan only. Or set DEVIN_API_KEY.

preferences.name: showGemini
preferences.label: Show Gemini
preferences.title: Show Gemini
preferences.description: Show Gemini usage in the list

preferences.name: showOpencodeGo
preferences.label: Show OpenCode Go
preferences.title: Show OpenCode Go
preferences.description: Show OpenCode Go subscription usage in the list

preferences.name: opencodegoApiKey
preferences.title: OpenCode Go API Key (Recommended)
preferences.description: Your OpenCode Go API key. Get it from https://opencode.ai/settings. Alternatively, set OPENCODE_API_KEY in your shell.

preferences.name: opencodegoWorkspaceId
preferences.title: OpenCode Go Workspace ID (Optional)
preferences.description: Cookie-login alternative to the API key: your OpenCode Go workspace id (both fields required).

preferences.name: opencodegoAuthCookie
preferences.title: OpenCode Go Auth Cookie (Optional)
preferences.description: Session cookie from opencode.ai — used only together with the Workspace ID above, when no API key is set.

preferences.name: showZai
preferences.label: Show z.ai (GLM)
preferences.title: Show z.ai (GLM)
preferences.description: Show z.ai (GLM) usage in the list

preferences.name: zaiApiToken
preferences.title: z.ai API Token (Optional)
preferences.description: Optional fallback token. Usually auto-detected from ZAI_API_KEY or GLM_API_KEY environment variable.

preferences.name: showAntigravity
preferences.label: Show Antigravity
preferences.title: Show Antigravity
preferences.description: Show Antigravity quota snapshots (via omp) in the list

preferences.name: showCommandcode
preferences.label: Show Command Code
preferences.title: Show Command Code
preferences.description: Show Command Code credit usage in the list

preferences.name: commandcodeApiKey
preferences.title: Command Code API Key (Optional)
preferences.description: Optional key. Usually auto-detected from ~/.commandcode/auth.json after `cmd login`, or COMMANDCODE_API_KEY.

preferences.name: showKimi
preferences.label: Show Kimi
preferences.title: Show Kimi
preferences.description: Show Kimi Code weekly + 5-hour quotas in the list

preferences.name: kimiCodeApiKey
preferences.title: Kimi Code API Key (Optional)
preferences.description: API key from the Kimi Code dashboard. Auto-detected from the Kimi Code CLI login or KIMI_CODE_API_KEY.

preferences.name: showSynthetic
preferences.label: Show Synthetic
preferences.title: Show Synthetic
preferences.description: Show Synthetic subscription quotas in the list

preferences.name: syntheticApiKey
preferences.title: Synthetic API Key (Optional)
preferences.description: API key from dev.synthetic.new (Subconscious quota lanes). Or set SYNTHETIC_API_KEY.

preferences.name: showClinePass
preferences.label: Show ClinePass
preferences.title: Show ClinePass
preferences.description: Show ClinePass 5-hour/weekly/monthly limits in the list

preferences.name: clinepassApiKey
preferences.title: ClinePass API Key (Optional)
preferences.description: ClinePass API key from the Cline app. Or set CLINEPASS_API_KEY / CLINE_API_KEY.

preferences.name: showDroid
preferences.label: Show Droid
preferences.title: Show Droid (Factory)
preferences.description: Show Factory Droid usage limits in the list

preferences.name: droidApiKey
preferences.title: Factory API Key (Optional)
preferences.description: API key from app.factory.ai/settings/api-keys. Auto-detected from FACTORY_API_KEY or ~/.factory/.env.

preferences.name: showMinimax
preferences.label: Show MiniMax
preferences.title: Show MiniMax
preferences.description: Show MiniMax Coding Plan model quotas in the list

preferences.name: minimaxApiKey
preferences.title: MiniMax API Key (Optional)
preferences.description: Coding Plan key (sk-cp-*) from platform.minimax.io. Or set MINIMAX_CODING_API_KEY / MINIMAX_API_KEY.

preferences.name: showMinimaxCN
preferences.label: Show MiniMax (China)
preferences.title: Show MiniMax (China)
preferences.description: Show MiniMax Coding Plan quotas via the China mainland endpoint in the list

preferences.name: minimaxcnApiKey
preferences.title: MiniMax China API Key (Optional)
preferences.description: Coding Plan key from platform.minimaxi.com. Or set MINIMAX_CN_API_KEY.

preferences.name: showGrok
preferences.label: Show Grok
preferences.title: Show Grok
preferences.description: Show Grok CLI credits in the list

preferences.name: grokBearerToken
preferences.title: Grok Bearer Token (Optional)
preferences.description: Auto-detected from the Grok CLI login (~/.grok/auth.json) or GROK_OAUTH_TOKEN. Paste a token here as fallback.

preferences.name: showAmp
preferences.label: Show Amp
preferences.title: Show Amp
preferences.description: Show Amp free tier + subscription usage in the list

preferences.name: ampApiKey
preferences.title: Amp API Key (Optional)
preferences.description: Access token from Amp settings. Falls back to `amp usage` CLI output when no key is set.

preferences.name: showAihubmix
preferences.label: Show AiHubMix
preferences.title: Show AiHubMix
preferences.description: Show AiHubMix account balance in the list

preferences.name: aihubmixApiKey
preferences.title: AiHubMix API Key (Optional)
preferences.description: API key (sk-*) from aihubmix.com. Or set AIHUBMIX_API_KEY.

preferences.name: pinnedProviders
preferences.title: Pinned Providers (Optional)
preferences.description: Comma-separated provider ids to pin at the top of the list and menu bar (up to 3)

preferences.name: cacheTtl
preferences.title: Refresh Interval (Seconds)
preferences.description: How often usage data is refetched from provider APIs. Applies to the list and menu bar (menu bar itself wakes hourly). Set to 0 to disable caching.

preferences.name: useOmpHarness
preferences.label: Use oh-my-pi harness
preferences.title: Use oh-my-pi harness
preferences.description: Reuse omp logins and quota snapshots as fallback sources (Claude, Codex, OpenCode Go, Antigravity)
